balls.text: low full toss, well outside off, hit to deep extra cover
bangs it short and pulled away to the deep square leg boundary
slower one now, waits before punching it to extra cover
goes for the yorker, ends up a a low full toss on the off stump, smeared down the ground. Raina gets across and dives but in vain
length delivery just outside off, swiped to midwicket
Holed out at long-off. Full and outside off, Malik sends it straight to Raina.
yorker to start with, driven hard to long-on for a single
moves across and belts the ball high towards long-on, Kapugedera is waiting for the catch here, easy one
tries to go aerial again but the ball just falls wide of the third man, scamper a two here
lashed away through the covers for four, scorching shot that
chips one straight to point there, full and outside off, slices it in the air and Kapugedera latches on to a regulation chance
full and on middle stump, dug out hard but Balaji makes an athletic stop by moving to his left
slower one and that's cut away fiercely for four, through deep point and beats the fielder
short again but he can't get the timing this time, thick edge from which he manages only a single
short and he's welcomed with a furious pull, Dhawan just backs away and blitzes that way over midwicket
full and on the pads, pulled away fiercely again, Vidyut gets around it at midwicket but can't get his hands to it, trickles away to the boundary, they're on a roll here
on the pads and that's swung away imperiously over short fine leg, clean hitting from the left-handers here
inside edge that trickles behind the keeper
too full and too wide, lifted crisply over extra cover for a four, he's in the zone here, finding the timing and the gaps
short one, pulled away behind square
down the ground again but beaten by the pace this time, can't swing in time and the deflection gives them another single
another one down the track, can't get the elevation and drives towards midwicket
fired back hard down the ground but that's a fine bit of fielding by the bowler, keeps them down to a single
charges down the track, taken on the full but driven straight to extra cover, Gambhir has backed up quite a bit but the throw from Balaji is wayward, Murali is a bit annoyed there
down the track again, but he can't get to the pitch of the ball, turned away to the on side
tossed up on middle and off, down the track from Gambhir and pushing to long-on for an easy single
retains strike with a glide to third man

slow ball goes completely awry, Gauti waits for it eagerly and hammers it over his head for four, that was nearly six but just pitched inside the ropes there, Gambhir is going bananas here, metal on the pedal
and another, full and wide, creamed away over extra cover, he's hitting the gaps superbly here, races away for four
that's brutal, short of a length and pulled away with disdain, through the midwicket gap for four, gets the placement just right and the power is awesome
short this time, goes for the pull but another one that balloons off the top of the bat, squirts to square leg
short of a length, Gambhir jumps down the track but can't get to that one, past his outside edge to the keeper
full toss on middle stump, driven hard into the ground, so hard that the ball bounces over the bowler and back down the ground, quick couple there
full and outside off, shuffles across and tries to work it away, can't get the timing right and they scamper another single
slower one on middle and leg, Gambhir looks for the big one on the on side but decides to angle the bat to third man instead, another run
cuts a short of a length ball towards point and takes off for a quick one, the fielder takes a shot at a direct hit but can't get the direct hit spot on
moves across and tries to swing towards backward square, misses that and it's called a wide down the leg side, that's a touch harsh on the bowler but anything down leg is a wide in this format
tapped to the off side, they take a quick one there

in the slot and Gambhir has pumelled that with ferocity, stands tall and swings his bat smoothly, all the way over midwicket for six. That gives him the orange cap, an honour for the highest scorer in the competition
tries to get back and pull hard but can't make contact again
worked away to short midwicket for a quick single
another one way down leg, Dhoni is furious there, collects the ball and throws it back under-arm with a tinge of anger
rapped on the pads this time, can't get the sweep right and there's a big appeal but you can't give those that pitch outside leg
down the track, taken on the full, driven powerfully to midwicket
outside leg, that's a wide by any standards, Gambhir can't make contact there
fuller this time, on the front foot and pushed to extra cover
slightly short and Dhawan tries to rock back and smash it through midwicket, can't get the timing right, though, and it pops close to him
full and outside off, square driven.
pushed to the off side. 100 up
still from round the stumps, full and outside off, swung to midwicket. Again Gambhir could have been run out had Kapugedera hit the stumps at the non-striker's end. Gambhir had again given up
slower one on the stumps, defended
full and outside off, cant reach it
on the middle and leg, swung past square leg
Whoa! A stunner! full one on the off and middle stump, Dhawan knives it over deep midwicket
slower one, defended on the front foot
full and on the middle stump, Gambhir opened his stance and lofted on mid-on
full and outside leg, misses the whip shot, and runs off the pad
full and outside off, lofted to covers
full toss outside off stump, carved to wide third man
outside off again, driven through covers
full and outside off, cut hard through backward point
slower one, short too, cut to deep covers
full and on the leg side, runs off the pad, First appeal for Bala in 2 years time.
from round the stumps, an open-chested action now - (he has revamped his action) well outside off, cut to wide thrid man
doosra on the middle stump line, goes back, picks it off the turf and defends
doosra but drifts to the pads, clipped to deep square leg
flighted across to the off side, pushed to extra covers
again shot and down leg, pulled to fine leg boundary
flighted full, driven to long-off
full in length, driven hard to covers
hurls it outside off, steered to third man
walked down the track, reached the pitch of a length delivery and over wide mid-on
outside the off stump, cut to the off side
short of length, well outside off stump, cut past point
turns down leg again and it runs off the pad. Tiffin signalled wide before changing it after Dhoni, who went all the way across, and Murali. Very very interesting.
down the leg side, misses the flick

Lucky escape for Gambhir. Almost run out . It was flighted full, on the middle and leg, Gambhir turned it to short fine-leg and set for the run and nearly didn't make it. Murali got a one-bounce throw which he deflected on to the stumps and the bails didn't come off the groove completely and only did, after Gambhir got his bat in. Lucky escape.
turns from outside leg but short in length and that allows Dhawan to work it through midwicket
flights across a off break on a length, tries to cut and gets a bottom edge that takes the ball between the legs of the 'keeper.
fullish, on middle and leg, worked to the on side
on a length, around off stump, tapped to backward point
Full and width offered out side off, Dhawan leaned across to cream it through covers. Lovely shot that.
full again, defended to the leg side
AB de Villiers goes for a first-ball duck. It was pretty fully, not a yorker but really full, and AB played all over it.
on  a length, on the stumps, turned to the leg side
Big wicket! Viru has fallen to a crashing yorker on the off stump. Gony has a lovely action and just flung this one fuller, at the base off the off stump and surprised Sehwag
short of length, outside the off stump, cut hard through point
full pitched, driven sweetly to mid-off
walks across the stumps and taps a length delivery on the off stump to the leg side for a single
short and Gambhir rocks on the back foot to pull it high and over midwicket
full and straight, driven hard to mid-on
tapped to wide third man for a single
slightly short of length, mistimes a pull to right of L Balaji - who is playing his first game - at mid-on.
full and outside off, driven hard to left of covers where Vidyut makes a diving stop
takes out the left leg out of the line and swings a full delivery to deep square leg
length delivery just outside off, punched to point
on a length, on the legs, worked past square leg
drifts on to the pads and Gambhir maintains his balance and glides it to fine leg boundary
shuffles across to work a length delivery to square leg for a quick single
length delivery on middle and off, Gambhir stays beside the line, waits before opening the bat-face to guide it to third man
overpitched and whipped past square leg and Raina makes a desperate dive near the ropes but he had touched the ropes in the process
ooh a beamer and Sehwag sways away in the nick of the time. That just slipped out of his hands

really full delivery, Sehwag falls a touch while trying to flick it away and is hit on the pad. And Gambhir would have been run out as he was sent back and had given up midway. But the throw from Raina was wild
leans forward to push to the on side
marginally drifts towards middle and leg, enough for Sehwag to whip it through midwicket.
Full pitched, on the middle and Sehwag drills it straight down the ground
Short of length, outside off, cut to deep point region
On a length, around off, turned to point region for a single
Just on a length, straighter, at the stumps, defended
Slap! short of length and outside off, Sehwag got up on his toes and just cut it hard over backward point. WOnder what Harbhajan thinks of that shot.
on the pads this time but Gambhir can't make contact with his leg glance but will pick up a leg bye
lovely delivery to start off with. In the zone outside off stump, off the uncertain length and Gambhir has a poke and is beaten

Almost caught but Chennai win! What a dramatic finish. Great effort from Shikhar Dhawan at deep midwicket boundary. Badri leaned forward and swung a loopy flighted delivery well to the left of deep midwicket but Shikar Dhawan rushed across quick and dived full stretch and some how managed to get his left hand to the rapidly dipping delivery. It was a incredible effort from him to get there and almost pull off a catch. But Gony and Badri have done the job when it mattered for Chennai. Phew. What a game.
turns in from outside off, Badri wanted to ping cover point but gets a inside edge down the track. 1 from 1. What a finish we have here. Will we have a bowlout?!
nice loopy delivery outside off, Badri stretched across to play a Hooper like chip shot over covers
loopy full toss outside off stump, mistimes his swing and will pick up a single to long on
What a profitable edge! Fuller, quicker, closer to the off stump, Gony swings, gets outside edge to third man boundary
Pressure makes Malik bowl a wide one outside off stump
Go go go gonyyyyy...... Malik slowed up the pace as he saw Goni come out but he adjusted, waited before heaving it over deep midwicket. Tension is killing here
another one, almost at the blockhole, outside off, dug out to covers
yorker from Yomi, on the leg stump line, jabbed to the off side. Super delivery that.
Super shot that. He backed away at the last minute and knifed a length delivery to deep extra cover region.
full, straight, driven to right of long-on
Another wicket is down and Delhi get ahead. Full and straight, driven hard but straight to long-off

What a stunning catch from AB. Dhoni had drilled a fullish delivery towards long-on and it was dipping rapidly on AB who was rushing forward. He dived forward to get his palms under the ball. Allan Border would understand Dhoni's feelings. He was out to a similar catch by Jadeja in the 1992 World Cup.
Yet another full toss from Asif, outside off stump, and hit straight to deep cover.
Another full toss from Asif and Dhoni puts this away to the midwicket boundary.
full one, drilled to right of long-off where Malik fields and sends in a powerful throw back

full and just outside off stump, Dhoni tries to paddle, then changes his mind seeing the length and tries to steer it to off side, misses and it runs off Karthik's pad. Karthik is standing up to the stumps
low full toss, mistimes his pull to deep midwicket. Had he got hold of it properly, he could have got a six. Lucky escape for Asif
low full toss on the middle stump line, paddled to left of McGrath who struggles to get across in time but manages to restrict it to a single
falls short of the blockhole, on the middle stump line, bottom-hand works overtime and he whips it down the ground for a single
full, at the base of the off stump, driven to long-off for a single. Just 6 runs so far
full one outside the off stump, squeezed off the inner edge to short fine leg
slightly short of length, pulled to deep midwicket
walks down the track and towards the off stump line, McGrath bangs it short and outside off, Kapu gets a top edge on the pull and over the 'keeper
right there almost at the base of the off stump, Dhoni can't do much but stab it to long on for a single
full toss on the off stump, paddled to McGrath at short fine leg
Kapugedera drives a full delivery to long on
low dipping full toss, swiped low to short midwicket, just short of Gambhir
fullish, driven down to long-on for another single
yorker length, jabbed to long-on
appeal for lbw and Tiffin calmly signals a leg bye. Kapugedera had walked across, got outside off stump and was struck outside off

Breaking news from Chennai: Dhoni's bat has broken Last time it happened in the IPL, it went for a six I think. McGrath hurled across a yorker on the base of the off stump and Dhoni just about managed to keep the ball out.
leans forward to swing a length delivery to deep midwicket
full in length, outside off stump, driven to the off side
yorker length outside off, punched to long-off. Again , that bottom-hand kicked in
on a length, on the stumps, pushed to Sehwag and this time they didn't run.

on the McGrath length, outside off stump, mistimes a pull past McGrath and sets for a run but Sehwag comes across from midwicket and has a direct hit. Big blow for the Kings but what a throw from Viru
fuller, almost on the blockhole, on the middle, squeezed to the off side
slightly short again, cut to covers
And now a four. What a let down! Outside the off stump and carved away powerfully to left of long-off.
Three in a row. Short and Albie rocked back to pull it easily to deep midwicket boundary. 6 6 6
backs to the leg side and drills a full delivery to the straight boundary.
There he goes. Floated on the leg and middle and Albie goes down on his knees to swing it high into the stands at deep midwicket. He is known for his big  hitting
fuller, on the stumps, mistimes a drive to midwicket
full in length, outside off stump and Albie flat-bats it powerfully to the left of long-on. Hmm...
length delivery outside off stump, hit on the up to long-off
again on the pads, again Dhoni gets into a tangle and it strikes the pad
full pitched, driven to long-off for a single
on the legs, full but Dhoni fails to put it away but picks up a leg bye
driven to long on
low full toss. Thank you says Dhoni and swings it to deep midwicket
comes out, almost yorks himself and digs it back to Sehwag
leans forward to drive it back to the bowler
just outside leg, clipped past square leg
charges out, Sehwag shortens the length and he swings it to deep square leg
slightly short, on the middle and leg, pulled to long leg
slips on to the pads, runs away to fine leg for a leg bye
on a length, on the pads, rolls over to the leg side
full and creamed along the ground to short covers
full in length, outside the off stump, poke and a miss
Full and outside off stump, driven square and straight to the backward point fielder. Dolly of a catch. Raina combusts on arrival.
on a length, outside off, ugly jab to the off side.
full and straight, driven to mid-on
on a length, on the stumps, squeezed past square leg
Caught at short covers. Full pitched, outside off stump, driven hard and low where AB pouches it. Good brisk innings but he should have carried on. An elegant innings by Mr Elegance himself
full pitched, Fleming drills it to deep extra cover where Dhawan rushes to his left to make a very good diving stop.
on the off stump, steered to backward point
miscued pull but there is no long-on. It was short in length, Dhoni tried to bottom-hand it away to midwicket but instead it went over mid-on and to the boundary
fullish, on the legs, tries to whip it away but misses and the ball rolls off the pad
it climbed off a length, surprised Fleming who did well to arch back and guide it to third man region. Very  well adjusted
stays back to force a length delivery to sweeper cover
outside off, flashed off the outer edge to third man
Fleming is really on a roll here. It was slightly short, a tad outside off and he was on the front foot, on a walk but adjusted to force it past the diving backward point fielder
turns in to Dhoni who punches it to midwicket
finally, shifts his line to the middle and Fleming squeezes it off the inner edge to square leg
Yet another sweep. Fleming goes down on his knee to play it in the air, over the square-leg umpire
again outside leg - what is going on here - swept hard past the short fine-leg fielder
slower but again down the leg side
goes for the sweep, misses
shortish, a quick arm-ball , cut hard to deep cover
floated full, driven to long-on for a single
on the pads, clipped to long leg
hurls this one fuller and Fleming hits it to deep extra cover. The timing is coming back for the black cap
What a whiplash square drive. It was on a length and outside off, Fleming was on the front foot but balanced himself nicely to pull off a rasping square drive
short of length, on the off stump line, lapped past square leg
brings Dhoni on strike with a dab to third man
Bangs this one short and Vidyut goes for the pull but the bat-handle rotates a touch in his hands and he couldn't find the proper timing. Caught at deep midwicket
walks a step or two down the track and heaves a full delivery to wide long on region. Chennai are moving along nicely
I spoke too early. Banged in short and Fleming pulls on the front foot to deep backward square leg
slightly short in length, Fleming goes for the pull but he has been unable to find any timing so far and edges this one on to his pad
full in length and Fleming hits it hard but straight to mid-off.
slower one but it was down the leg side. The 'keeper couldn't gather it cleanly either.
Another profitable charge. Again, he moved outside leg and scooped a full delivery inside-out over long-off. Vidyut is on the bike here
Vidyut backs away outside leg and smokes a length delivery - he hit on the up and through the line- to long-on boundary. One bounce over the ropes
swinging yorker ends up a low dipping full toss, off the bottom half of the bat to wide mid-off
full and on the leg stump line, he had backed away a touch, trying to hit through the off side and this line cramped him and he just pushed it to extra cover
short of length now and steered to backward point
full pitched and Vidyut plays a nice lofted shot over wide mid-on region. the bottom-handle took over rather effectively
down the leg side and the 'keeper, standing up to the stumps, gets his body behind it to make a half-stop
shuffles outside the off stump, tries to pull a length delivery and mistimes it to midwicket but takes the single
on a length, outside off stump, tapped to backward point
full in length, just outside off stump, hit to mid-off
charges down, making room to the leg side in the process, the bowler follows him and he adjusts to push it past the bowler
on the legs, misses the flick shot and the ball strikes the pad
shortish, outside off stump, Fleming tries to force it through the offside but can't get his timing right and the ball rolls towards mid-off. The throw is slightly wide and they take the over throw
outside the leg stump, flicked and McGrath at short fine leg can't get down in time to make the stop but Shoaib Malik rushes across from long leg to kick the ball into play
hits the deck short of length, around the off stump, tapped to wide third man
full in length, on the middle and leg, turned to right of midwicket for a quick single
bangs it short and Vidyut, who seems to love the pull, sends it to deep midwicket region
on the legs and Fleming tries the pick-up shot but misses and the ball rolls off the pad
yorker length, Fleming arrested his front foot movement - it was going across - and brought his bat down in a hurry to jab the ball to mid-on
charges out at McGrath who keeps it full and turns it to midwicket region for a single
short in length, just outside the off stump, squeezed to point
shortens the length and Fleming wrists the ball from the middle stump line to fine leg region
Wow! gorgeous cover drive. The tall Fleming leaned across to unfurl a cover drive to a full pitched delivery. Very elegant.
fuller, around the off stump, mistimes a on drive this time to mid-on. The bat face shut early
similar delivery and he mistimes a drive to the off side and Asif rushes to his right to make the stop
partly edged partly steered. Full in length, outside off, Vidyut didn't move too close to the line and had a flash with an open-face of the bat
Vidyut is on the hunt here. First McGrath, now Asif. He stretched across to slice a full length delivery over point
leans forward to dead-bat a full delivery on the off side
full again, Vidyut is on the front foot and on drives to wide mid-on
fuller, Vidyut lets the ball come  to him before pushing it to the off side
Vidyut is handling McGrath with aplomb. Again a short delivery and again, Vidyut rocked back to pull it hard and over midwicket.
fuller and it shapes in touch, Vidyut is cramped up, gets struck on the pad, outside off
Rarity - a first-ball boundary for McGrath. It was short in length, on the stumps and pulled away ferociously
